name: Wakka, Devoted Guardian
oracle_text:
Reach, trample
Whenever Wakka deals combat damage to a player, destroy up to one target artifact that player controls and put a +1/+1 counter on Wakka.
Blitzball Captain — At the beginning of your end step, if a counter was put on Wakka this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
blocked_sentences: Blitzball Captain — At the beginning of your end step, if a counter was put on Wakka this turn, put a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.

needs.what: a value (or condition) counting counters put this turn on one specific object, here the source itself, by any player and of any kind: "if a counter was put on <this permanent> this turn" as an end-step intervening-if. Needs the turn ledger's CountersPut records to carry the recipient object id so a value like {"counters_put_this_turn": {"objects": {"self_only": true}, "player": "any"}} can filter on it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: counters_put_this_turn filters only by who put the counters (put_by), counter kind and the recipient's card types; CountersPut in engine/structs.py records no recipient oid, so it cannot tell a counter on Wakka from one on any other creature. counters_on reads counters currently present, not counters put this turn (a +1/+1 counter later removed, or annihilated by a -1/-1, would be missed, and pre-existing counters would wrongly count). A counter_placed self trigger setting a turn flag read by has_turn_flag would add an unprinted triggered ability that uses the stack
